THE DETERMINISTIC COMIC RENDERING METHOD (client-side, no AI)

1. HASH THE ITEM: SHA-256 of the item's ID. The first bytes choose the palette
   (palette index = byte0 mod 6) and the background (byte1 mod 4). Same ID always
   yields the same artwork — fully reproducible on any device.
2. BOLD OUTLINES: every shape gets a black stroke of 4-6px. Thick outlines are the
   single biggest contributor to the comic look.
3. FLAT COLOR FILLS: fills come only from the chosen 4-color palette. No gradients.
4. HALFTONE SHADING: a <pattern> of small dots overlays shadow regions at 35%
   opacity — classic print-comic shading, done in pure SVG.
5. SPEED LINES: 5-9 radiating lines behind the subject suggest motion and energy.
6. CAPTION BOX: a white box with a 3px black border carries the title in bold
   sans-serif, like a comic narrator box.
7. COMPOSITION: subject centered at (200,170) on a 400x360 canvas; caption at top.

PIPELINE (JavaScript or Python): hash -> palette -> shapes(motif) -> halftone overlay
-> speed lines -> caption -> serialize SVG. Runs entirely client-side in milliseconds.
